subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the Matrix QA migration land together with the production Gateway channel-restart admission change, or should that lifecycle change be reviewed and proven in a separate PR before this stack proceeds?
rationale: Source and proof support the QA migration, but repository automation cannot decide whether the production lifecycle change belongs in this refactor or whether its availability risk has sufficient owner review.

options.title: Split Gateway lifecycle change
options.body: Move runOutsideGatewayRootWorkAdmission and its reload call-site changes to a focused PR with dedicated restart, shutdown, and failure-path proof, then land the QA migration after dependency authorization.

options.title: Approve the combined scope
options.body: Keep the production change in this PR only after the Gateway owner accepts the coupling, the exact-head dependency transfer is authorized, and the runtime-topology gate passes.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its dependent release-workflow PR until the admission-lifetime design and dependency ownership are resolved.

recommendation.title: Split Gateway lifecycle change
recommendation.body: Move runOutsideGatewayRootWorkAdmission and its reload call-site changes to a focused PR with dedicated restart, shutdown, and failure-path proof, then land the QA migration after dependency authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current stacked QA migration and the merged predecessor, so they are the best available coordinator for splitting or documenting the intended coupling.
